scope: All 43 selected outputs owned by scene_anatomy_gate, including 41 already published files and two unpublished The Anomaly phases. 65 human faces compared against canonical portrait crops. Discarded generation candidates are not product assets and were not re-audited.
method: Manually located native-resolution head crops; each shown directly beside canonical anchor, 310x350 contain scaling with no stretching. All 11 proof sheets reviewed. Clothing and accessories are not treated as a substitute for facial morphology. Perspective/expression ambiguities are marked moderate.
releaseDecision: All selected outputs withheld from merge fragment until strict identity review passes. Original scene files and PNGs are untouched. Removal from fragment does not undo earlier parent merges; parent must remove or quarantine already merged routes.
previousGateCorrection: Earlier anatomy QA correctly found and fixed limb defects but was too permissive about identity. Prior claims of canonical identity are superseded by this review.
